channel.title: Thrive with Therapy
channel.description: Conversations on nervous system regulation, couples communication, EMDR trauma processing, and emotional wellness with Vanessa M. Sierra, LMFT.

featured.title: The Human Connection We're Losing in a Digital World | Vanessa Sera
featured.description: Therapist Vanessa Sera discusses the nuances of couples therapy, the impact of telehealth and AI on mental healthcare, and the vital need to maintain authentic human connection in an increasingly virtual world.

episodes.title: Somatic Tools for Calming Acute Anxiety & Nervous System Dysregulation
episodes.description: Practical somatic grounding exercises you can use immediately when feelings of panic, overwhelm, or hypervigilance take over.

episodes.title: Breaking the Overthinking Loop: How Cognitive & Somatic Therapy Work Together
episodes.description: Why thinking your way out of anxiety often keeps you stuck, and how nervous-system-informed therapy creates sustainable physiological calm.

episodes.title: Repairing After a Conflict: How Healthy Couples Reconnect
episodes.description: A step-by-step breakdown of how to initiate a repair attempt without triggering defensiveness, using principles from the Gottman Method.

episodes.title: Attachment Styles in Adulthood: Anxious, Avoidant & Secure Dynamics
episodes.description: Discover how early developmental attachments unconsciously steer partner selection, intimacy thresholds, and emotional vulnerability.

episodes.title: Demystifying EMDR Therapy: What Actually Happens in an EMDR Session?
episodes.description: A clear, clinical explanation of bilateral stimulation, memory reprocessing, and what clients experience during EMDR trauma treatment.
